_how: Pre-mission run settings. Every number the planner uses is here; nothing is hard-coded. Units: seconds, metres, m/s.
_throughput: cell-updates/s per device come from bench/throughput.json[solver]; assumed_per_device is used only when that entry is missing, and is labelled as assumed
_shares: fraction of budget_s per level, split across the drones that use it; the rest is the ensemble and headroom
_media: U: characteristic relative speed. nu: kinematic viscosity (sets the hull boundary-layer thickness). L2a/L2b: nest box [x, y, z] in m.
_hull: L3 is graded: the boundary-layer shell around the hull at hull resolution, then bands doubling outward (each with its own CFL step) to the L2b spacing, inside a box of box_lengths body lengths. wall_dx_min: wall-modelled LES first cell (y+ 30-100); nothing finer is ever planned (no wall-resolved LES).
